requirements.source_quote: Signal names ending in `_x` exist once per data lane. Unless stated otherwise, signals are active High.

requirements.source_quote: | `hs_settle_cyc` | 19 ⚠️ | Length of DL_HS_TERM, which ends with the start of the sync search (§4.6): places that start after THS-SETTLE,min and before the first 1 of a leader sent at the minimum THS-PREPARE + THS-ZERO, for the AFE word latency Λ (Appendix B, ADR-007); 19 at 1500 Mb/s with Λ = 2 ⚠️.

requirements.source_quote: Rate dependent: software programs the value of Appendix B for the line rate before enabling the lanes ⚠️

requirements.source_quote: | `clk_settle_cyc` | 36 ⚠️ | Centre of TCLK-SETTLE (95–300 ns → ~200 ns) minus the LP detection latency (~20 ns); counted from entry into CL_HS_TERM |

requirements.source_quote: | `tinit_cyc` | 20 000 | TINIT,SLAVE ≥ 100 µs (D-PHY §6.11 ✅) |

requirements.source_quote: | `hs_rx_timeout_cyc` | 2^18 (1.31 ms) ⚠️ | Longer than the longest burst: 5802-byte line at 80 Mb/s on one lane ≈ 580 µs; the longest burst per lane is OPEN K8 |

requirements.source_quote: - **Toggle synchronizer.** A one-cycle event inverts a flip-flop in the source clock. The level crosses through two flip-flops, and a third flip-flop with an XOR gate turns each change into a one-cycle pulse in the destination clock.

requirements.text: Two events of one kind crossing a toggle synchronizer shall be at least three destination cycles apart; each event crossing this way occurs at most once per burst or per LP sequence.
requirements.source_quote: apart; each event listed above occurs at most once per burst or per LP sequence ⚠️.

findings.text: The v0.4 precedence rule sends a lane that sees LP-11 in DL_HS_RQST, DL_LP_RQST or DL_ESC_RQST through DL_ERR and back to DL_STOP on the same LP-11, while DL_ERR holds errcontrol_x 'until the next line-state change' [CSI] C13. The line stays LP-11, so it is not stated whether errcontrol_x stays high while the lane already reports Stop, or for how long.
findings.source_quote: that row takes precedence: the lane passes through DL_ERR, raising `errcontrol_x`, and then returns to DL_STOP ⚠️.
findings.proposed_default: errcontrol_x stays high until the next line-state change after that LP-11 (the next LP-01 or LP-10), per C13, while the lane is already in DL_STOP; confirm with the CSI team that a Stop state with errcontrol_x high is acceptable.
